purpose: Machine-checkable rules the ship-lens-reviewer agent applies against every diff. Adds money-surface parity rules per the money-surface rule from desktop-2/CLAUDE.md (LOCKED 2026-07-10). Design OS routes stay under the current behavioural gate only.

rules.applies_to: money_surface_routes OR folder-name matches docs/mockups/approved/*.html basename
rules.check: Route file MUST contain a comment or code-level string reference to the approved mockup path (e.g. 'docs/mockups/approved/<name>.html' OR '05_html-mockups/approved/<name>.html'). Grep pattern: /mockups\/approved\/[a-z0-9-]+\.html|approved\/[a-z0-9-]+\.html/.
rules.failure_message: Money surface must reference an approved mockup. Missing citation to desktop-2/docs/mockups/approved/<name>.html.

rules.applies_to: money_surface_routes AND the matching approved mockup HTML contains a <video> tag
rules.check: If desktop-2/docs/mockups/approved/<name>.html contains '<video', the route file MUST render <SafeVideo> or <video> AND MUST reference an MP4 source in one of the approved video buckets. Two-pass check (JSX props often wrap across lines): (1) grep_a = /(<SafeVideo|<video)/ ; (2) grep_b = /\/(brand\/founder\/founder-|brand\/walkthroughs\/|demos\/)[a-zA-Z0-9\-]+\.mp4/i. Both must match at least once. Rationale: APPROVED_SOURCE.md explicitly allows founder-hook / walkthrough / demo MP4 buckets per surface (some surfaces show demo walkthroughs, not a Daniel-to-camera founder video).
rules.failure_message: Approved mockup declares a <video> tag but the React route does not render <SafeVideo>/<video> AND reference an MP4 in /brand/founder/, /brand/walkthroughs/, or /demos/.

rules.check: Route file MUST expose 3+ visible states via `data-state=` attributes OR a typed useState<StateKey> declaration whose union type has 3+ distinct string literals. Count either the number of unique `data-state="..."` string literals OR the number of `|`-separated string literals in the state union type.
rules.failure_message: Money surface must expose 3+ visible states. Fewer than 3 data-state or useState union members detected.

rules.check: Diff MUST NOT introduce any `lcDiag("..._rendered"` OR `emitAdminEvent("..._rendered"` call. Grep pattern: /lcDiag\(["'`][a-z_]*_rendered/ OR /emitAdminEvent\(["'`][a-z_]*_rendered/.
rules.failure_message: Introduced *_rendered event. Behavioural events only — no render-lifecycle telemetry.

rules.check: account-app/src/components/admin/JourneyMapTab.tsx MUST contain a JOURNEYS row whose `citation` field references the surface file (basename match acceptable) AND has `pipeline: "section"`, `surface_type: "money"`, non-null `mockup_path`. If pipeline/surface_type/mockup_path are omitted from the base row, the derived values from `enrichJourney`/`pipelineFor`/`surfaceTypeFor`/`MOCKUP_BY_JOURNEY_ID` MUST resolve to those values.
rules.failure_message: Money surface has no Journey Map metadata (missing row, or row exists but pipeline/surface_type/mockup_path do not resolve to section/money/<mockup>.html).

rules.check: Wallet (routes/wallet-detail/WalletDetail.tsx) MUST be mounted through <SectionWithFallback SectionComponent={WalletDetail} FallbackComponent={LegacyEarnFallback} /> in sections/account/AccountSection.tsx. This is the only Section-pipeline surface with a real legacy fallback (design-os EarnRoute). Other Section-pipeline surfaces (Outreach, Campaigns, Learn, Cancellation, Catalog) intentionally do NOT mount SectionWithFallback and are exempt from this rule — see desktop-2/CLAUDE.md "Fallback resilience · scoped to Wallet only" (LOCKED 2026-07-10).
rules.failure_message: Wallet is no longer wrapped in SectionWithFallback. Restore the mount in sections/account/AccountSection.tsx or update this rule scope.

rules.check: Files matching desktop-2/src/design-os/routes/**/*.tsx BYPASS money-surface-1, money-surface-2, money-surface-3, money-surface-5, money-surface-5b. Rule money-surface-4 (no *_rendered) STILL applies.
rules.failure_message: N/A · this rule is a scope override, not a failing rule.

rules.check: Money surface render body MUST be wrapped in Watchdog + EngineErrorBoundary. Grep pattern: /(<Watchdog[^>]*>|watchdogWrap\(|EngineErrorBoundary)/. Presence of any ONE of the three counts as a wrap. Coverage inherited from the parent section shell (AccountSection/OutreachSection/CampaignsSection) also counts if the surface is mounted through the Section registry — treat inherited coverage as a pass when the parent shell wraps the surface component.
rules.failure_message: Money surface has no Watchdog/EngineErrorBoundary wrap. Add a Watchdog boundary around the render body OR rely on a wrapped Section shell.

self_test.description: The reviewer agent can run these three self-tests to confirm the rules load correctly.
